name: Seated Cable Row
summary: A seated horizontal row on a low cable that gives constant tension on the mid back, lats and rear delts with low technical demand.
setup: Attach a V-handle or close-grip handle to a low pulley and sit with the feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Lean forward to take the handle, then sit upright with a neutral spine and chest up.
Start with the arms extended and the shoulders set down.
execution: Pull the handle toward the lower ribs, driving the elbows back along the body.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the end.
Let the handle return slowly, stretching the arms forward.
mistakes: Rocking back and forth: lighten the weight and keep the torso nearly still.
Shrugging the shoulders: keep them down as you pull.
Rounding the back at the stretch: only reach forward as far as the spine stays neutral.
Pulling with the hands: think elbows to the hips.
